decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 18(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation areas) Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [1110-P001, 1110-P002, 1110-P010, 1110-P011, 1110-P012, 1110-P013, 1110-P020, 1110-P021, 1110-P022, 1110-P023, 1110-P024, 1110-P025, 1110-P026, 1110-P027, 1110-P028, 1110-P110, 1110-P112-A, 1110-P113, 1110-P120, 1110-P124, 1110-P125, 1110-P126, 1110-P128, 1110-P129, 1110-P131, 1110-P132, Heritage Impact Assessment and Design & Access Statement, Flood map for planning and Fire Strategy. Received: 24/12/2024
Daylight & Sunlight Assessment Rev B. Received: 20/03/2025
1110-P111-A and 1110-P123-A. Received: 11/04/2025
1110-P121-A, 1110-P122-B, and 1110-P127-A. Received: 25/04/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
description: Listed building consent for the erection of a first floor rear extension, repair, refurbishment and reinstatement, together with adaption to facilitate the use of The Old Post Office as an architects office and design-studio
subdivision_of_building: Works only to the ground floor part of the building, with extension to the first floor
